column3: Close to the Hebrew; the present “they light up … it sees” is rendered in the past, “lit up … saw.”
Close to the Hebrew; the present “they melt” is rendered “melted,” and “from before” as “at the presence of.”
Close to the Hebrew; “they see” is rendered “have seen.”
Close to the Hebrew; “an image” is rendered “graven images,” “worthless idols” as “idols,” and “bow down” as “Worship.”
Close to the Hebrew; NASB adds “this” after “heard.”
NASB reads “You are the LORD Most High”; the Hebrew says “you, O Yahweh, [are] most high.”
Close to the Hebrew; “lives” is rendered “souls,” and “his faithful ones” as “His godly ones.”
NASB adds “like seed” to “Light is sown.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the remembrance of his holiness” is rendered “His holy name.”
